name: infraenv-monorepo
description: Portable AI infrastructure learning and S2 simulation runtime

scripts.build: npm run content:check && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/shared && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/protocol && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/simulation && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/storage-gateway && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/supervisor && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/validator && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/runtime && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/cli && npm run build --workspace @infraenv/web-ui
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run playground
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run docs:check && vitest run
